description: Boundaries of the strategic public transport plans is a data set listed in data.gov.il, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministry of Transport and Road Safety. Its tags are GIS, חצב, ממג, תחבורה, תכניות אסטרטגיות. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX, ZIP. The portal shows 2023-03-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-il-portal.
